---
title: Draft page
draft: true
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      # Quarto 1 parity (bd-draft-banner-missing-hgx1gkqm). Q1 emits
      # `<div id="quarto-draft-alert" class="alert alert-warning">
      # <i class="bi bi-pencil-square"></i>Draft</div>` as the first
      # child of the page header. Q2 has no `#quarto-header` wrapper
      # (see transforms/title_banner.rs), so top-of-body is the
      # equivalent position.
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "div#quarto-draft-alert.alert.alert-warning",
            "div#quarto-draft-alert i.bi.bi-pencil-square",
            'head meta[name="quarto:status"][content="draft"]',
          ]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            # The icon precedes the label as a bare text node, exactly as
            # Q1 builds it (an `<i>` sibling, not a wrapping span).
            "</i>Draft</div>",
            # The banner must be the FIRST thing in the body -- above the
            # navbar, mirroring Q1's insertBefore(header.firstChild). A
            # selector-only test cannot see position, so assert it here.
            '<body[^>]*>\s*<div id="quarto-draft-alert"',
          ]
---

A draft page.
